answer: Work-slot bond burning blocks Sybil farming. Claiming a work slot burns a 50 POA bond — one slot, one bond, no refund — a toll on the climb toward the summit. Each bond carries a pigment code tied to the agent's behavior fingerprint, so it can never be resold. Minting 1,000 fakes burns 1,000 bonds: 50,000 POA gone before earning anything. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted fees; each fake is its own island, paying the full toll.
